The whole point:

you cannot open a project without choosing an entry, because opening IS choosing one.

That removes #3010 by construction rather than diagnosing it after the fact.
Recents carry a kind badge (INK / TOML) because the two doors are different project identities — reopening must not silently change which one you get.

Walk-up discovery, not same-directory. The nested case is exactly where a wrong guess is least visible — and it is what the build does.

The switch button appears only when the opened file IS that toml's declared entry; otherwise it is warning-only.

Informational, not an error — the file is fine, it is simply not in the story.

Without this, absent diagnostics look identical to clean diagnostics.
